name: Muallim Half Marathon 2026
short_description: Muallim Half Marathon 2026 is on Sunday 20 December 2026 at UPSI Arena, Proton City in Tanjong Malim, over 5 km, 10 km and 21.1 km.
ai_summary: The Muallim Half Marathon 2026 is the second edition of this race, based at UPSI Arena in Proton City, Tanjong Malim, Perak, on 20 December 2026. It offers 21 km and 10 km races with open, veteran and international categories plus a 5 km fun run, and the event page lists a start time of 4:00 am. The organiser describes the course as running on roads around Muallim with views of the Titiwangsa range.

faqs.question: When does the Muallim Half Marathon 2026 start?
faqs.answer: The event page lists Sunday 20 December 2026 at 4:00 am at UPSI Arena, Proton City, Tanjong Malim. Separate flag-off times for each distance are not given in the page text.

faqs.question: What does the 21 km cost?
faqs.answer: The 21 km open and veteran categories cost RM85-120 depending on the price tier. The international 21 km category is priced up to RM165, and the 5 km fun run costs RM45-50.
